issues.summary: Getting started and migration-guide failed initial navigation with ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED, no HTTP status and zero observed bytes. Their accountingStatus complete_within_protocol describes no unresolved captured requests, not a successful complete page load. Both pages were accessible in independent probes/context. Seven pages were attempted; five staged main documents returned HTTP 200.
issues.requestedChange: Display unavailable (failed navigation) for page transfer/emissions cells, not 0 kB or zero carbon. Exclude failed navigations from successful-page averages, low-weight claims and any declared annual page-mix option while retaining raw zero/error records. State 7 attempted / 5 HTTP-200 initial pages; do not infer persistent site failure.

issues.summary: All five HTTP-200 initial captures remain partial: each has an unfinished assets/javascripts/workers/search.2c215733.min.js record with receivedBytes null. Their totals (142700, 148262, 147317, 190118 and 145240 bytes) exclude unresolved transfer accounting, and all ratings are not_calculated. Main-session scope cannot establish whether this is worker-target accounting rather than a functional search failure.
issues.requestedChange: Preserve observed bytes as partial and the unrated result. Do not assign the missing worker zero bytes or diagnose broken search/resource loading from the unfinished CDP record. An explicitly partial-input annual scenario is possible only with stated assumptions and cannot establish rating eligibility.

issues.summary: Measured search-to-installation failed at the homepage Page.goto with ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED. It performed no actions and has no completion observation; search input, results, selection and installation content were never exercised in that run. The earlier bounded setup task completed successfully.
issues.requestedChange: Describe measured journey as unavailable due to initial navigation error, alongside the successful setup walkthrough. Do not call this evidence that search failed, the visitor hit an account/payment barrier, or the documented installation route is unusable. Request a fresh matched journey through the coordinator only if stronger runtime evidence is required.

issues.summary: Home, configuration and alternative-engines lack successful primary desktop/narrow/live preference/print/keyboard captures because their primary navigation failed. Home cold-dark, configuration no-JavaScript and API no-JavaScript failed independently. Other isolated contexts succeeded, so absence/difference across missing states cannot establish site behavior.
issues.requestedChange: Retain applicability and mark missing comparisons unresolved; cite successful isolated states only within their scope. Do not treat missing metadata/forms/fonts or no-JavaScript failure due to ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED as a site defect or an inapplicable check, and do not inflate whole-sample passes from the four completed primary probes.

issues.summary: Successful initial runs use no_banner with no consent actions. after_consent and after_scroll repeat cumulative totals with zero deltas. These checkpoints do not provide accept/reject paths, independent loads, complete media activation tests or measured consent savings.
issues.requestedChange: Lead with initial captured transfer; label later numbers cumulative and no consent action performed. Do not sum checkpoints or claim that consent/scroll caused zero additional traffic. Establish notification/consent/media applicability from observed features before judging their requirements.

issues.summary: Several successful pages requested a page-relative sitemap.xml that returned HTTP 404. These observed resource errors are distinct from the unresolved worker records, and an HTTP error response can still contribute captured traffic. A sitemap error does not alone prove failed visitor tasks, absent metadata across the site, or a deployment-source fix location.
issues.requestedChange: Preserve any fully accounted 404 traffic in totals and describe the narrow repeated request observation separately from partial-byte accounting. If recommending a path correction, label it an investigation until request purpose and deployed configuration are established; do not make repairing this resource a prerequisite for the audit.

issues.summary: Coverage is initial load plus 500 ms in the main CDP target; multiple scripts have functionsTruncated=true. Unused source positions are not transfer bytes or removable code, especially for later search interactions. Twelve Tab presses, short motion/notification windows and collected download links do not test a complete keyboard journey or document accessibility.
issues.requestedChange: Keep findings state-specific, avoid precise whole-bundle unused/removal savings from truncated ranges, and preserve unknown later functionality. Do not infer no notifications, no motion, no downloadable documents or full keyboard usability from these bounded probes.

issues.summary: GreenFrame covers only the homepage with three complete repetitions, versus seven attempted staged pages. Its client-device median is 0.01141742601821111 Wh/scenario; top-level clientDeviceEnergy is the mean 0.011471336231618518. This is modeled browser-container CPU/memory/disk and synthetic screen energy, with network separate, remote servers excluded, and a different container/browser flag/user-agent setup.
issues.requestedChange: Report the requested three-repetition median with its observed range and explicit 1/7 energy coverage; do not describe it as a full page-sample result or measured electricity. Request missing-page energy through the coordinator if full sample remains required. Preserve full scenario/window and uncontrolled-workstation limits; never add device/network/total energy to SWDM or treat repetition range as a confidence interval.

issues.summary: Public purpose and alternative-engine documentation explain a Python ContentState conversion need and engine tradeoffs, but do not establish all desirability/feasibility/viability evidence or unpublished creation/continuation decisions. Migration guidance is applied compatibility content with retained historical upgrade instructions; date labels do not establish review schedules or ownership.
issues.requestedChange: Preserve contextual assessmentScope exactly, distinguish publisher statements from verified practice, and retain missing decision/lifecycle evidence as unresolved. Do not infer unnecessary service, absent maintenance processes or a reason to delete historical compatibility instructions from these gaps.

issues.summary: The audited documentation lives under /draftjs_exporter/ on the broader wagtail.github.io origin. Disclosure discovery reports only presence not established within scope and no verified claims. Origin-level hosting or traffic estimates can include other projects and cannot silently become project-specific annual utilization.
issues.requestedChange: Name the project path in report scope, keep discovery/hosting unknowns explicit, and require matched project traffic or an explicitly declared origin-to-project allocation for annual scenarios. Do not equate missing discovery records with absent policies or assume green hosting from the platform identity.
